prompt: Of the participants in the first round of the 2024 Yucatán Open (Doubles), which Mexican player had received two wild cards during their career prior to August 4, 2024?
answer: The Mexican player was **Rodrigo Pacheco Méndez**. He competed in the first round of the 2024 Yucatán Open doubles event with Gonzalo Campaña Lee and had received two career wild cards before August 4, 2024.
